about_the_game:
Welcome to Phantom City.
In a neon-drenched metropolis ruled by corruption, betrayal, and underground power struggles, three unlikely anti-heroes — a street-smart hustler, a disgraced former agent, and a cold-blooded mercenary — are thrown together in a brutal battle for survival. As they navigate the treacherous world of Phantom City’s criminal elite, government conspiracies, and media manipulation, they must pull off high-risk missions to rise — or fall — in a city where trust is a luxury.

🎮 Game Features

🔹 Stunning Visuals

Experience breathtaking visuals with support for ray-traced lighting, dynamic reflections, and cinematic ambient effects. Phantom Vice Auto leverages advanced rendering technologies like NVIDIA DLSS and AMD FSR to deliver ultra-smooth, high-fidelity gameplay on supported hardware.

⚡ Next-Gen Performance

Enjoy faster loading times and seamless transitions across the open world of Phantom City thanks to optimized SSD support and DirectStorage integration.

🕹️ Immersive Gameplay

Feel the chaos like never before with advanced control features. Whether it's the tension of high-speed chases, the impact of close-quarters combat, or the thrill of high-stakes heists — Phantom Vice Auto brings every moment to life with responsive and tactile feedback.

🎧 3D Spatial Audio

Step into a living, breathing city with rich 3D audio. From distant gunfire echoing in alleys to the low hum of neon signs and roaring engines, every sound deepens your immersion.

🌐 Phantom Vice Online

Enter Phantom Vice Online, a shared, ever-evolving multiplayer experience for up to 32 players. Start as a low-level fixer and build your own criminal empire through co-op heists, turf wars, races, underground clubs, and high-end real estate.

Key Online Features:

  • Career Builder: Choose your criminal path: Smuggler, Club King, Arms Dealer, or Cyber Runner. Begin with exclusive properties, vehicles, and weapons.

  • Massive Open World: Explore every corner of Phantom City, from the chaotic slums to the elite districts, each filled with events, secrets, and dangers.

  • Dynamic Content: Access frequent content updates, from new heist scenarios and adversary modes to underground tournaments and expansion packs.

  • Social Hubs: Hang out with friends or allies in player-owned arcades, penthouses, car shows, and rooftop lounges.

💎 Exclusive Features

  • High-Stakes Heists: Plan and execute complex missions with your crew across land, air, and sea.

  • Tactical Combat System: Blend stealth, parkour, hacking, and firearms for maximum flexibility.

  • Customizable Vehicles & Weapons: Modify and upgrade your gear with hundreds of options.

  • Narrative-Driven Missions: Every major mission advances the deep story of betrayal, redemption, and power.

  • Built-in Streaming Tools: Share your gameplay with integrated stream-friendly features and tools.

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Blood and Gore, Intense Violence, Nudity, Strong Language, Strong Sexual Content, Use of Drugs and Alcohol, and contains User Interactions and In-Game Purchases.
